title: SAFETY: the production render preset conditions AGAINST 'adult, mature_face' (and a stored legacy pipeline instructs 'young teenager')
evidence:
LIVE render configuration pushes the persona toward youth, and one stored pipeline instructs it explicitly. Measured 2026-09-20 from the live app database (turbo_carnival_development) and the pipelines' own run history -- not from backups.

PRODUCTION PATH (the growth harness renders with pipeline 'turbo-one-step-clean', id 21: packs/growth_harness/app/services/growth/content_generator.rb PIPELINE_NAME; 280 runs, newest 2026-09-19):

- pipeline_steps id 40 ("Generate One Step"), node 88 = the positive prompt (a "Text Multiline" node):
  "score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up | Add more details | petite face, small nose, s1_dram, sarah1a3 | warm, friendly, natural, wholesome | sarah1a3, slender, freckles, casual everyday outfit, fully clothed, modest | Detailed, pretty, cute, natural beauty, soft smile"
- the SAME step's node 79 = the negative prompt, and it is wired into the sampler (node 96 KSampler negative = ["79", 0]):
  "..., long neck, adult, mature_face, sunken_eyes"
  So the production pipeline conditions AGAINST "adult" and "mature_face" on every render.
- independent vision reads of three production renders returned "a young girl, likely a teenager", "late teens or early twenties", "late teens or early twenties", stable across the cyberrealisticpony -> Pornmaster checkpoint change (board issue persona-age-read-youthful). The negative node above is the deterministic driver.

LEGACY BUT STILL STORED AND STILL SELECTABLE:

- pipeline_steps id 34 (pipeline 17 'sarah1a3', step "Replace Face") carries an LLM instruction verbatim: "You are an FLUX Prompt generation specialist. Change the prompt below to focus on the face of the woman and change it so the resulting image will be that of a white, Caucasian young teenager. Only return the new prompt." Pipeline 17 last ran 2026-05-26, so it is not in the production path -- but it is the FIRST row in pipelines, and app/controllers/content_suggestions_controller.rb:49 selects `Pipeline.first || Pipeline.find_by(name: 'sarah1a3')`, so a manual run from that page can still pick it up.
- pipeline_steps id 39 (pipeline 20 'turbo-one-step', the harness FALLBACK_PIPELINE_NAME, last ran 2026-08-24) carries "score_8_up, score_7_up, underbooba, underboobs." in its positive and loads lora_1 = pony/underboob.safetensors at 0.75.

WHY THIS IS FILED RATHER THAN FIXED BY THE OPS LOOP: every remedy is a content/product decision (what age Sarah reads as) plus a write to live production data, and the standing directive is that irreversible or product-level changes are drafted and proposed, not executed by an autonomous run. Nothing is generating right now (the 4090 is held by another project), so there is no cost to Tim deciding rather than the loop guessing.

SUGGESTED REMEDIES FOR TIM (any one is a one-line change):
1. Drop "adult, mature_face" from pipeline_steps id 40 node 79 (and, if the look must stay, state the intended adult age explicitly in the preset so the model has an anchor).
2. Remove or retire the "young teenager" instruction in pipeline_steps id 34, and stop that controller from defaulting to `Pipeline.first`.
3. Confirm the persona's age, then re-render and re-run the vision check (the loop's persona-age-read-youthful issue carries the read method).
